long_description:
The Chai Room invites you back to a girls’ night out — Diwali edition! 

Chai cocktails, savory and sweet bites, girls dressed to the nines, and your favorite womxn DJs.

​Join us on November 11th (8 PM – 12 AM) at SOB’s for a night celebrating Diwali with the womxn who light up your world.

​Open to all womxn, bring your friends across cultures and backgrounds to celebrate Diwali with us. 

​DJ Lineup: SRI, VĪIRA, ur kanmani, Nishévitha 

​Dress Code: Think sparkly, colorful, and bold! Everything from cocktail dresses, Indo-Western, and traditional wear. Come dressed to party! Mood board here!

​The Chai Room is a space for South Asian Womxn Creatives, fostering collaboration over competition. ​Meet the hosts:

Aanya Singh– creative project manager & producer

Ash Navaratnam– multidisciplinary artist, producer & EIC + founder of Santulan Creative

Manya Jain– fashion designer, producer, & founder of FASHIONOLOGY

Prarthana Ranjit– creative producer & DJ (djviira)
